title: My day
simplified_paragraphs: 明天要去深圳出差， 我计划今晚就准备好出差的东西。 明天早上七点一刻起床， 洗漱完就出发。 坐地铁太浪费时间了， 所以我准备打车去机场， 车上还能再睡四十五分钟。 到了机场差不多八点半， 可以吃个早餐， 然后准备登机。 上飞机以后， 买个空中wifi ， 然后准时参加公司九点的线上会议。 下飞机以后等同事来接我， 然后去酒店放行李。 中午约朋友吃午饭。 下午两点差十分准时到达公司的深圳办公室， 开始下午的工作。 大概工作四个小时左右， 我就可以回酒店休息了。 这就是我一天的计划。
traditional_paragraphs: 明天要去深圳出差， 我計劃今晚就準備好出差的東西。 明天早上七點一刻起床， 洗漱完就出發。 坐地鐵太浪費時間了， 所以我準備打車去機場， 車上還能再睡四十五分鐘。 到了機場差不多八點半， 可以吃個早餐， 然後準備登機。 上飛機以後， 買個空中wifi ， 然後準時參加公司九點的線上會議。 下飛機以後等同事來接我， 然後去酒店放行李。 中午約朋友吃午飯。 下午兩點差十分準時到達公司的深圳辦公室， 開始下午的工作。 大概工作四個小時左右， 我就可以回酒店休息了。 這就是我一天的計劃。
pinyin_paragraphs: míng tiān yào qù Shēn zhèn chū chāi，  wǒ jì huà jīn wǎn jiù zhǔn bèi hǎo chū chāi de dōng xi。  míng tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn yī kè qǐ chuáng，  xǐ shù wán jiù chū fā。  zuò dì tiě tài làng fèi shí jiān le，  suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǔn bèi dǎ chē qù jī chǎng，  chē shàng hái néng zài shuì sì shí wǔ fēn zhōng。  dào le jī chǎng chà bu duō bā diǎn bàn，  kě yǐ chī gè zǎo cān，  rán hòu zhǔn bèi dēng jī。  shàng fēi jī yǐ hòu，  mǎi gè kōng zhōng wifi，  rán hòu zhǔn shí cān jiā gōng sī jiǔ diǎn de xiàn shàng huì yì。  xià fēi jī yǐ hòu děng tóng shì lái jiē wǒ，  rán hòu qù jiǔ diàn fàng xíng li。  zhōng wǔ yuē péng you chī wǔ fàn。  xià wǔ liǎng diǎn chà shí fēn zhǔn shí dào dá gōng sī de Shēn zhèn bàn gōng shì，  kāi shǐ xià wǔ de gōng zuò。  dà gài gōng zuò sì gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu，  wǒ jiù kě yǐ huí jiǔ diàn xiū xi le。  zhè jiù shì wǒ yī tiān de jì huà。
english_paragraphs: I'm going on a business trip to Shenzhen tomorrow, and I plan to prepare things for the business trip tonight. Get up at 7:15 tomorrow morning, wash up and set off. Taking the subway is a waste of time, so I plan to take a taxi to the airport. I can still sleep for another 45 minutes in the car. It’s almost 8:30 when we arrive at the airport. We can have breakfast and then prepare to board the plane. After getting on the plane, buy in-flight WiFi, and then attend the company's nine o'clock online meeting on time. After getting off the plane, I waited for my colleagues to pick me up, and then went to the hotel to put my luggage. Meet friends for lunch at noon. I arrived at the company's Shenzhen office on time at two o'clock in the afternoon and started my afternoon work. After working for about four hours, I can go back to the hotel to rest. This is my plan for the day.

We can have breakfast and then prepare to board the plane. After getting on the plane, buy in-flight WiFi, and then attend the company's nine o'clock online meeting on time. After getting off the plane, I waited for my colleagues to pick me up, and then went to the hotel to put my luggage. Meet friends for lunch at noon. I arrived at the company's Shenzhen office on time at two o'clock in the afternoon and started my afternoon work. After working for about four hours, I can go back to the hotel to rest. This is my plan for the day.
